variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'They spend their days in prosperity' fits both the qere יְכַלּוּ (כלה, complete/spend) and the ketiv יבלו (בלה, wear out/use up); ASV renders the same idiom with בלה at Job 36:11 as 'spend their days in prosperity', so 'spend' does not distinguish the readings. No textual note on the verse. Base qere fallback carries the projection.
